verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח אֱ֭לֹהִים אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יֶעְשַׁ֥ן בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl lə·’ā·sāp̄ lā·māh zā·naḥ·tā lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ap·pə·ḵā ye‘·šan bə·ṣōn mar·‘î·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: A Maskil of Asaph Why have You rejected us forever . . . O God Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨׀ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה׀ שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr ‘ă·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā qā·nî·ṯā qe·ḏem gā·’al·tā šê·ḇeṭ na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā har- ṣî·yō·wn zeh šā·ḵan·tā bōw
verses.literal: Remember Your congregation which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance Mount Zion . . . where You dwell

verses.original: הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ נֶ֑צַח לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת כָּל־ בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ אוֹיֵ֣ב הֵרַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: hā·rî·māh p̄ə·‘ā·me·ḵā ne·ṣaḥ lə·maš·šu·’ō·wṯ kāl- baq·qō·ḏeš ’ō·w·yêḇ hê·ra‘
verses.literal: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed

verses.original: צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ שָׁאֲג֣וּ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·rə·re·ḵā šā·’ă·ḡū bə·qe·reḇ mō·w·‘ă·ḏe·ḵā śā·mū ’ō·w·ṯō·ṯām ’ō·ṯō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place they have unfurled their banners as signs

verses.original: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת׃ בִּֽסֲבָךְ־ עֵ֝֗ץ לְמָ֑עְלָה
verses.transliteration: yiw·wā·ḏa‘ kə·mê·ḇî qar·dum·mō·wṯ bi·să·ḇāḵ- ‘êṣ lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees

verses.original: וְעֵת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן׃ יָּ֑חַד פִּתּוּחֶ֣יהָ בְּכַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת
verses.transliteration: wə·ʿēṯ ya·hă·lō·mūn yā·ḥaḏ pit·tū·ḥe·hā bə·ḵaš·šîl wə·ḵê·lap·pōṯ
verses.literal: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks

verses.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן־ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šil·ḥū ḇā·’êš miq·dā·še·ḵā lā·’ā·reṣ ḥil·lə·lū miš·kan- šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: They have burned . . . Your sanctuary to the ground they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name

verses.original: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל־ מוֹעֲדֵי־ אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mə·rū ḇə·lib·bām nî·nām yā·ḥaḏ śā·rə·p̄ū ḵāl mō·w·‘ă·ḏê- ’êl bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They said in their hearts We will crush them completely They burned down every place where God met us in the land

verses.original: לֹ֥א אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין־ ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא־ אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד־ מָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’ō·w·ṯō·ṯê·nū rā·’î·nū ’ên- ‘ō·wḏ nā·ḇî wə·lō- ’it·tā·nū yō·ḏê·a‘ ‘aḏ- māh
verses.literal: There are no signs for us to see There is no longer any prophet And none of us knows how long this will last

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים צָ֑ר יְחָ֣רֶף אוֹיֵ֖ב יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣār yə·ḥā·rep̄ ’ō·w·yêḇ yə·nā·’êṣ šim·ḵā lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: How long . . . O God will the enemy taunt You Will the foe revile Your name forever

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִֽימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב חוֹקְךָ כַלֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯā·šîḇ yā·ḏə·ḵā wî·mî·ne·ḵā miq·qe·reḇ ḥō·qə·ḵå̄ ḵal·lêh
verses.literal: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand Stretch it out . . . to destroy them

verses.original: וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wê·lō·hîm mal·kî miq·qe·ḏem pō·‘êl yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Yet God [is] my King from ancient times working salvation on the earth

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ יָ֑ם בְעָזְּךָ֣ שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh p̄ō·w·rar·tā yām ḇə·‘āz·zə·ḵā šib·bar·tā rā·šê ṯan·nî·nîm ‘al- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: You divided the sea by Your strength You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh riṣ·ṣaṣ·tā rā·šê liw·yā·ṯān tit·tə·nen·nū ma·’ă·ḵāl lə·‘ām lə·ṣî·yîm
verses.literal: You crushed the heads of Leviathan You fed him . . . to the creatures of the desert

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ אֵיתָֽן׃ נַהֲר֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ḇā·qa‘·tā ma‘·yān wā·nā·ḥal ’at·tāh hō·w·ḇaš·tā ’ê·ṯān na·hă·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: You broke open the fountain and the flood You dried up the ever-flowing rivers

verses.original: י֭וֹם לְךָ֣ אַף־ לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm lə·ḵā ’ap̄- lə·ḵā lā·yə·lāh ’at·tāh hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯā mā·’ō·wr wā·šā·meš
verses.literal: The day is Yours and also the night You established the moon and the sun

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל־ גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּם׃ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh hiṣ·ṣaḇ·tā kāl- gə·ḇū·lō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ ’at·tāh yə·ṣar·tå̄m qa·yiṣ wā·ḥō·rep̄
verses.literal: You set all the boundaries of the earth You made the summer and winter

verses.original: זְכָר־ זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף׀ יְהוָ֑ה נָ֝בָ֗ל וְעַ֥ם נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- zōṯ ’ō·w·yêḇ ḥê·rêp̄ Yah·weh nā·ḇāl wə·‘am ni·’ă·ṣū šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Remember how the enemy has mocked You O LORD how a foolish people has spurned Your name

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּ֣ן נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ לְ֭חַיַּת אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tên ne·p̄eš tō·w·re·ḵā lə·ḥay·yaṯ ’al- tiš·kaḥ ḥay·yaṯ ‘ă·nî·ye·ḵā lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever

verses.original: הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס׃ מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ
verses.transliteration: hab·bêṭ lab·bə·rîṯ kî nə·’ō·wṯ ḥā·mās mā·lə·’ū ma·ḥă·šak·kê- ’e·reṣ
verses.literal: Consider Your covenant for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land

verses.original: אַל־ דַּ֣ךְ יָשֹׁ֣ב נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- daḵ yā·šōḇ niḵ·lām ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn yə·hal·lū šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame may the poor and needy praise Your name

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִנִּי־ נָ֝בָ֗ל חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh ’ĕ·lō·hîm rî·ḇāh rî·ḇe·ḵā zə·ḵōr min·nî- nā·ḇāl ḥer·pā·ṯə·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Rise up O God defend Your cause Remember how the fool mocks You all day long

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiš·kaḥ qō·wl ṣō·rə·re·ḵā šə·’ō·wn qā·me·ḵā ‘ō·leh ṯā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually
